description: SS 22 credit for an under-65 individual retired on total disability (mirrors TaxCalcBench ty25-us-010): QSS, AGI 16,000 (wages 12,000 incl. an 11,000 code-3 disability pension reported as wages + 4,000 interest). Initial = min($5,000, disability income 11,000) = 5,000; minus 1/2 x (16,000 - 7,500) = 4,250 -> SS 22 amount 750 x 15% = 112.50 -> $113 (Schedule R whole dollars) - the reference return's credit. Hand-computed from SS 22(a)-(d) verbatim.
